name: BALEFUL SCRIPT
text: Once per battle, as a free strategic gambit, change one of your Accursed Gifts to one nobody has selected. If it was an operative's Abhorrent Mutation gift, only that operative changes.

name: COVERT GUISES
text: When revealed, roll a D3. As a free strategic gambit in the first turning point, that many Devotees wholly in your drop zone may make a free Reposition that must end wholly within 3" of it.

name: UNHOLY TALISMAN
text: Once per turning point, when an operative shoots a friendly cult operative, retain one of your normal defence successes as a critical success instead.

name: VILE BLESSING
text: Once per battle, when an attack die inflicts Normal Dmg on a friendly cult operative that is not a Devotee, ignore that damage. A Mutant or Torment uses either this or the Unnatural Regeneration roll on that die, not both.
